record.title: Implement typed offline evidence manifest sealing and verification
record.intent: Turn the first evidence boundary into a reusable library and delegated CLI.
requirements: Use versioned TOML manifests and explicit typed outcomes; provide seal and verify operations with no network or device I/O and no overwrite of existing seals.
Reject missing changed truncated duplicate unsafe path and escaping symlink inputs, unsupported schema versions, and observed concurrent changes; retain explicit non-atomic snapshot limits.
Test independent library and CLI consumers, including failure cases; describe an existing private run in a new external manifest without changing sealed evidence.
acceptance: Meaningful positive and negative controls pass and the independent private-run comparison is preserved.
